title: Stored XSS in comment rendering via unescaped markdown image title
description: Comments are rendered by render/markdown.py. The image syntax with a title attribute passes the title through to the output tag without HTML-escaping, so a title containing a closing quote and a script tag is injected as raw HTML and runs in the context of other users viewing the comment. render_image() builds the tag with an f-string and never escapes the title.
poc_text: Post a comment with an image whose title attribute is: "><script>alert(document.cookie)</script>
